confirmedFindings.title: Exponential polynomial backtracking regular expression (ReDoS)
confirmedFindings.body: Evaluating nested quantifier regex /^([a-zA-Z0-9]+)+$/ against non-matching repetitive input triggers catastrophic exponential backtracking, blocking the Node.js single-threaded event loop.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Simplify regex to /^[a-zA-Z0-9]+$/ without nested repetitions or use linear-time string validation.
